paper_title: Yet another proof of the strong law of large numbers
text:
\begin{lemma} Let $X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots $ be i.i.d.~r.v.~with $ \mathbb{E}[X]>0$. Then $ \inf_{n \geq 0} (X_{1} + \cdots + X_{n})$ is finite a.s.
             \end{lemma}
